title: UMB-HMP-only Illumina 16S inputs for the grip R Journal paper
description: Minimal microbial feature counts and technical sample metadata from the Ravel-led University of Maryland Baltimore Human Microbiome Project (UMB-HMP) longitudinal vaginal cohort, required to rebuild the 4,391-vertex graph used in the grip R Journal software paper. UMB-HMP was an HMP demonstration project distinct from the NIH HMP healthy-reference cohort. The archive excludes clinical variables, participant identifiers, host sequence, and all records from the related U01 cohort present in the historical working source.
keywords: University of Maryland Baltimore Human Microbiome Project
